d: Bihar ke sivan jile men sthit mandal kara (jel) men kanun-vyavastha aur suraksha vyavastha ka jayja lene ke lie jiladhikari (DM) vijay prakash mina ki aguvaee men prashasnik aur pulis tim ne achanak auchak nirikshan (chhapemari) kiya. is dauran jel ki sabhi kothriyon (Cells) aur sanvedanshil hisson ki gahan talashi li gaee.
